title: The Memory of a Meal
question: When does a compressed state admit an exact deterministic update?
method: Elementary factorization proof; independently checked one-step timer-deletion witness.
finding: Equal codes with unequal encoded successors forbid an exact deterministic reduced update.
claim_scope: The theorem for deterministic maps on stated domains; the DEEP witness for a domain containing the natural checkpoint and reset counterfactual.
limitations: No claim of natural reachability for reset clone.
No general impossibility of compression or complexity claim.
